name: 风云之风起云涌
english_description: A Gu Long-themed “Storm” (风云) MUD whose actual built world is thin: only about 48 files carry real room descriptions, most scattered across individual wizards' personal directories rather than a complete official town/sect map. The one substantially finished official area is the Kaifeng yamen (衙门) scene, populated by Judge Bao (包拯) and Zhanzhao (展昭). Registration uniquely splits a recovery/admin password from the everyday login password. Deep testing surfaced a cluster of severe, previously-undocumented programming bugs rather than content gaps: a missing type-check in the message() simul_efun crashed every single re-login once the channel daemon finished loading (a new bug class), plus two zero-return-value crashes in make_inventory()/unew() that could silently void an entire room's object list or an NPC's equipment loadout. Also confirmed by design, not a bug: the apprenticeship/sect system itself works, but no NPC in the shipped content ever actually sets a sect to join. See NOTES.md for the full fix list.
